title: ADR-028 closeout: mark review-lens and review-report as migrated
goal: Fix ADR-028 and its guard test to reflect that review-lens and review-report ARE migrated to _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate, closing out the record left behind by #1840/#1843.

steps.description: Fix the guard test: update header comment to describe review-lens as migrated (not the unmigrated counter-example); fix SPEC-3 to exclude comment lines when grepping for extract_first_json_object so it takes the correct 'migrated' branch; fix SPEC-2 to also cover review-lens and review-report and to search all non-test .sh files under each plugin directory (not only plugin.sh, since review-report's parser lives in lib/lenses.sh). Run npm test to confirm SPEC-3 fails before the ADR is updated (the test asserts migrated state; the ADR still contradicts it — red step), then proceed to step-2.

Amend ADR-028 §Migration: (1) in the 'Per-stage gates added' list, add entries for _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok and _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok with their gate criteria; (2) in the Migration paragraph (line 187), add review-lens and review-report to the migrated-stage list; (3) replace the 'not migrated' paragraph (line 189) with a dated migration note citing #1840/#1843; (4) in the bullet at line 193, remove the false 'review-lens was not migrated' claim. Preserve the 2026-09-02 correction note — it is history. Run npm test and npm run lint to confirm all green.

notes: The code is already correct (both plugins use _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate). Only two files change. Step-1 must be written and verified RED before step-2: the acceptance criteria require stating the assertion and how it failed at the merge-base. The RED condition for SPEC-3 is that the current test passes for the wrong reason (comment match triggers 'not migrated' branch); after step-1 the fixed grep excludes comment lines and the test asserts the 'migrated' branch — this is RED against the current ADR (which still says 'not migrated') because the SPEC-3 'migrated' branch now runs unconditionally but nothing else fails SPEC-3 by itself; SPEC-3 passes green regardless of ADR content. The actual RED step for SPEC-2 is easier: adding review-lens and review-report to the loop immediately checks them against the code, and since the code is already migrated, SPEC-2 should go green immediately. The PR body must note: SPEC-3 assertion is 'review-lens migrated — no stale claim possible'; before fix, grep matched a comment so the test took the wrong 'not migrated' conditional branch entirely (never ran the migrated assertion). Assumption: monitor plugin exists and is already covered; no changes needed to its checks. review-report's lib directory contains no test .sh files, so 'non-test .sh' search is straightforward (exclude files matching tests/ path). Possible gap: need to verify the _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok function name against the actual code — the issue cites plugins/agent/review-report/lib/lenses.sh:162 which shows _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok. ADR-028 has no '## Enforced by' section yet — if lint-adr-enforced-by.sh requires it, that may cause a lint failure not covered by this plan. The baseline file config/adr-enforcement-baseline.txt should be checked to confirm ADR-028 is listed there (grandfathered). If not listed, an Enforced by section would also need to be added.
